0.desc: As the mist filling the chasm clears, some of it coalesces into the form of a young girl, who gazes towards you with tearful eyes. She moves her mouth to speak, but you can't hear her voice no matter how hard she tries. However... you get the sense that she is searching for something. You may be able to learn more about Azmoth Chasm if you help her.

normal.textMain: Show her Drak's research notes.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You show #fc0xccffffff#Drak's research notes#fc0xccc7dfe0# to the young girl.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: The moment her eyes fall upon Drak's reasearch, the girl erupts into a soundless scream. You hurriedly conceal the notes again, but it's too late--the young spirit has been overcome with utter terror. She flees into the wall of the chasm, and as you examine the spot where she disappeared you find something embedded in the sand...

special.textMain: Offer her the demon rag doll.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You take out the #fc0xccffffff#demon rag doll#fc0xccc7dfe0#.
special.result: The young girl gasps with silent delight, and for a moment you're not handing the doll to a mournful spirit but a living, breathing child who is recalling memories long-erased by the curse of Azmoth. You close your eyes as the young girl disappears into a blinding light, only later realizing that a container of strawberry-scented syrup was left in the place where she stood.

normal.textMain: Tell her that she'll find what she's looking for if she keeps trying.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You cheer the young girl on, telling her that she'll definitely find what she's looking for.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: The young girl gives you a gentle smile, which for a moment seems to chase away the darkness that devoured Azmoth. She offers you a translucent pinky, and the two of you swear to never give up. As she disappears, you see an item in the spot where she was standing.

normal.textMain: Ignore the spirit and keep moving.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You turn your back on the spirit and keep moving.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: Child or no, no spirit is safe in a place like this. The young girl watches you leave with sullen eyes, but soon vanishes back into the mist.

1.desc: As you enter a crumbling building, you blink to see a cat dozing on a fallen stone. It's certainly adorable, but what is a fluffy feline doing in a place like this? And do cats normally have wings?

normal.textMain: Toss the grave robber's backpack towards the cat.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You take out the #fc0xccffffff#grave robber's backpack#fc0xccc7dfe0# and gently toss it towards the cat.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result:
The cat's pupils widen as the backpack soars through the air, and it bounds down to where it falls, eagerly pawing at the cloth. As its head emerges from the backpack with something shiny in its mouth, the cat's eyes latch upon yours. Suddenly, words form in your mind:

"Wait here."
The cat appears a moment later, carrying a peculiar tome in its mouth.

special.textMain: Toss the barbed arrowheads towards the cat.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You gently toss the #fc0xccffffff#barbed arrowheads#fc0xccc7dfe0# towards the cat.
special.result: With a trilling mew, the cat jumps down and gingerly picks up the arrowheads with its mouth. Flapping its wings, the cat leaps into the air, and your mind is suddenly filled with an image of a treasure hidden in the ruins beside you. You blink and rub your forehead, but the cat has already vanished. In the rubble you can see something glimmering.

normal.textMain: Offer the cat a treat.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You take out a cat treat you had in your pocket and offer it to the cat of the chasm.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: The cat of the chasm sniffs the treat dubiously, before gagging as if he is about to throw up. Glaring at you, he stands and leaves in a huff, his fluffy tail twitching with annoyance. Disappointed, you watch the cat go, but then realize that there's an item in the spot he was sitting.

normal.textMain: Glare at the cat so it knows you mean business.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You glare at the cat, hoping to scare it by looking as dangerous as you can.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: The cat of the chasm does a big stretch, yawns, and then turns over to take a nap. Somewhat humbled, you turn to leave.

2.desc: You see a crystal set into the ground before you, a fluctuating orb floating above it. With a start, you realize that it must be one of the arcane turrets Luvar encountered. It doesn't look operational anymore, but you may learn something if you take a closer look.

normal.textMain: Examine the area with your research gear.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You reach into your #fc0xccffffff#Explorer's Pack#fc0xccc7dfe0# and pull out your research gear.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: You examine the area surrounding the arcane turret, taking in the deep grooves carved into the stone beneath its crystal. As you take your measurements, you come across an item dropped by someone who came through the chamber before you.

special.textMain: Pour the dusty blood vial into the groove beneath the crystal.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#With a grunt, you pry open the #fc0xccffffff#dusty blood vial#fc0xccc7dfe0# and pour it into the groove beneath the crystal.
special.result: With a gentle hum, the arcane turret reactivates, scanning its surrounding with a light the color of blood. You jump as a bolt of crimson lightning suddenly erupts from the turret... only for it to shoot past you and obliterate a monster that had been creeping up behind you. Luckily for you, the beast drops something as it falls.

normal.textMain: Search through the bones piled around the turret.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You search through the remains scattered around the turret.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: Some cadavers and rusty gear scattered around the arcane turret catch your eye. Most of them are crumbling from age, but perhaps one of the monsters felled by the turret was carrying something useful...

normal.textMain: Only fools trust strange cats. Get out of there.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You leave quickly, taking the long way around the cat.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: The cat takes no notice of you as you flee into the depths of Azmoth.

3.desc: You unexpectedly come face-to-face with a silver-haired, red-eyed warrior who has a long cape flowing out behind her. Her demonic heritage is obvious at a glance.\n\n"Go home, outlander. You don't belong here. Aidan and Azrael's lives are mine."

normal.textMain: Ask if she'd like to trade.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You ask the warrior if she has anything to trade.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: The warrior bends down and picks up a rock, flinging it at you with expert aim and striking you in the forehead. You drop your item and flee, eyes stinging with tears, only to realize later that the rock bounced into your bag.

special.textMain: Show her the wanted posters you found.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You hand the #fc0xccffffff#stack of wanted posters#fc0xccc7dfe0# over to the warrior.
special.result: The warrior laughs mirthlessly as she sees the stack of wanted posters in your hands.\n\n"It's rare that I drop something. Here. Fair payment for bringing them back to me."

normal.textMain: Tell her that you're not interested.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You tell the warrior that you have no interest in fighting the monsters of the chasm.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: The warrior looks at you suspiciously before turning to leave, accidentally leaving her bag behind. Something must have unnerved her.

normal.textMain: Glare. You're not letting your guard down.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You glare at the warrior, daring her to fight you.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: The warrior shakes her head dismissively before turning away, contempt in her gaze.\n\n"Go ahead if you want. I'll tell your friends where to find your body, if they ever come looking."

4.desc: As you cross through the chasm, Fanzy unexpectedly calls out to you, running up breathlessly with his hat and rucksack bouncing up and down. He looks around to see if anyone is listening before leaning in, whispering that he's discovered something big.\n\n"I think the people who lived here... were from Tynerum!"

normal.textMain: Give Fanzy the Alchemist Stone.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You ask Fanzy if he's interested in the #fc0xccffffff#Alchemist Stone#fc0xccc7dfe0#.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: Fanzy takes the Alchemist Stone eagerly, certain that it was created with the sorcery of Tynerum. Grinning broadly, he shakes his head, and a silver coin tucked into his hat flies out and lands in your palm.\n\n"Here! I was sure that coin was from Tynerum, but this stone is much more valuable for our research!"

special.textMain: Give Fanzy the Arcane Defense Manual.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You hand Fanzy the #fc0xccffffff#Arcane Defense Manual#fc0xccc7dfe0# and ask if it backs up his theory.
special.result:
Fanzy opens the Arcane Defense Manual and slowly runs his paws over the schematics inside. After thinking for a moment, he looks up to you.

"This magic is unlike anything I've ever seen before. I have to get this book back to Master Grendel!"
To thank you, he shrugs off his bag and reaches inside for something to give you.

normal.textMain: Tell him that's an amazing discovery.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#Impressed, you tell Fanzy that he's made an incredible discovery.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result:
Fanzy triumphantly takes out several relics from his bag, explaining how each one supports his theory in exhaustive detail. But once his lecture is done, Fanzy only puts some of them away.

"Here, you can have this one. Maybe it will help you make your own discoveries!"
As you pick the item up, you realize Fanzy was probably just tired of his bag being heavy.

normal.textMain: Gently tell Fanzy that you knew that already.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#Suppressing a sigh, you tell Fanzy that you knew that already.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result:
Fanzy coughs awkwardly.

"Uh, good! I'm glad we're on the same page! Let me know if you learn anything else!"
As Fanzy turns to leave, you suddenly realize that there's movement in the ruins behind him. It's the cat of the chasm, peering at Fanzy with tremendous amusement.

5.desc: You find 10 Boogies dressed up like an explorer, examining some ruins ahead of you. From the pleased look on her face, you gather that she's learned some interesting things from the chasm.\n\n"Oh, hello! I'm glad to see you here--Neinheart sent me to find out if the knights need to be deployed to Azmoth!"

normal.textMain: Offer her the grave robber's backpack as evidence.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You take out the #fc0xccffffff#grave robber's backpack#fc0xccc7dfe0# and offer it to her as evidence.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: 10 Boogies's eyes light up and she accepts the backpack cheerfully. Eager to investigate its contents later, she empties out her own bag to make room, handing you a potion made by Magatia's Alchemists that she had been carrying.

special.textMain: Offer her the bloody alchemy tools as evidence.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You show 10 Boogies the #fc0xccffffff#bloody alchemy tools#fc0xccc7dfe0# you found.
special.result:
Frowning, 10 Boogies looks over the bloody alchemy tools.

"Something was very wrong with the alchemists here, that's for sure."
To make space for the tools in her bag, 10 Boogies shares some of the evidence she collected with you. That way, you both have something to bring back later.

normal.textMain: Ask if you can see what she's collected.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You ask 10 Boogies if you can see the evidence she's gathered.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: 10 Boogie takes the artifacts she's collected out of her bag, spreading them on the ground before you. As she explains each item to you, she realizes that she's carrying too many to make it through the chasm safely, and offers one to you instead.

normal.textMain: Cheer her on.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You encourage 10 Boogies by cheering her on.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: 10 Boogies perks up, reenergized by your enthusiasm. She takes off running, eager to make more discoveries, but only makes it a few steps before tripping and falling to the ground. Out of sight behind her, you wince.

6.desc: Athena Pierce appears ahead of you, looking like she's just come from a fierce battle. In her arms are several artifacts she gathered as she ventured through the chasm.\n\n"Azmoth was not built into the earth... it's as if the rock swallowed this place whole, like Leafre suddenly appeared above it... or it suddenly appeared beneath Leafre."

normal.textMain: Give Athena your emergency protection spell.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#Worried about Athena's safety, you hand her the scroll containing the #fc0xccffffff#emergency protection spell#fc0xccc7dfe0#.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: Athena accepts the spell scroll from you gratefully. In exchange, she gives you a chunk of mysterious ore she found in the chasm.\n\n"Here. I know not what this is, but I'm sure it will be helpful to you."

special.textMain: Show Athena the heretical icon.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You hand Athena the #fc0xccffffff#heretical icon#fc0xccc7dfe0# and ask if she knows what it is.
special.result:
Athena Pierce holds up the icon warily, its unsettling eye seeming to absorb the light around it.

"I fear that Azmoth Chasm may be far older than we think... and that we are not the first outsiders to venture here."
Before she leaves to explore further, she gives you something to help your own investigation.

normal.textMain: Listen to Athena's findings.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You listen as Athena Pierce begins describing the things she's learned in Azmoth Chasm.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: In hushed tones, Athena Pierce shares the discoveries she's made in Azmoth Chasm. Through bloody rites, the sorcerers of Azmoth created artifacts of awesome power... including, Athena believes, a demonic blade of terrible strength forged though a hideous sacrifice. She tells you that there is still much to uncover, and gives you some supplies to help your own journey through the chasm.

normal.textMain: Keep moving. You don't have time to talk.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You tell Athena that you have to keep moving and that you'll talk to her later.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: Athena Pierce nods and turns to leave as well.\n\n"Stay on your guard. Azmoth may be dead, but its grave is far from quiet."

7.desc: A shiver runs down your spine as you suddenly realize that the cavern behind you is echoing with footsteps. You whip around, scrambling for your weapon, before heaving out a sigh of relief--it's only Danika, Elluel's Elder of War. She's answered Athena Pierce's call and come to explore Azmoth Chasm.

normal.textMain: Show her the Whispering Tome.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You hand Danika the #fc0xccffffff#Whispering Tome#fc0xccc7dfe0# and ask what she makes of it.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: Eyeing the Whispering Tome with a distasteful look on her face, Danika guesses that it once belonged to one of the innumerable sorcerers who lived and performed wicked rites in the city of Azmoth. Grateful that you've kept such a dangerous artifact out of the wrong hands, Danika hands you an Explorer's Pack to refresh your supplies.

special.textMain: Show her the gnawed femur.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You hand Danika the #fc0xccffffff#gnawed femur#fc0xccc7dfe0# and ask what she makes of it.
special.result:
Danika lets out a long whistle, clearly impressed.

"There's no way this came from the monsters living around here... But look at these teeth marks! I wonder if it was a treat for that dog Luvar saw. He said it was cute, but I think he was just trying to block out how massive it was."
Danika hands you an item she thinks will help you avoid becoming the beast's lunch.

normal.textMain: Ask if she's found anything.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You ask Danika if she's found anything.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: Danika can't say for certain, but she's pretty sure that Azmoth Chasm is far from stable. The dimensional tear at the heart of the chasm is definitely new, and she feels that the accursed souls inside Azmoth are using the opportunity to flee if they can. Finishing her hypothesis, Danika lays out a few artifacts she found, asking if any catch your eye.

normal.textMain: Tell her to stay safe and hurry on your way.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You tell Danika to stay safe out there and continue on your way.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: The words are barely out of your mouth before Danika disappears, vanishing into the depths of the chasm. You follow her example.

8.desc: You come face to face with Hellin, the Thief Priest, deep in her own explorations of Azmoth. Before either of you can say anything, her stomach grumbles, the noise echoing off the stone walls around you. Embarrassed, Hellin admits that she rushed into the chasm without eating breakfast and asks if you have any food you could spare.

normal.textMain: Show her the Gladiator's Amulet.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You take out the Gladiator's Amulet and show it to Hellin.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: After staring at the amulet for a long while, Hellin shows you a terrible whip she found in the chasm. She shakes her head with a heavy heart.\n\n"No punishment could ever repay the crimes committed by the rulers of Azmoth."

special.textMain: Give her your emergency rations.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You quickly offer her the #fc0xccffffff#emergency rations#fc0xccc7dfe0# in your bag.
special.result: Hellin snatches the emergency rations from your hand, turns her head, and shoves them into her mouth in one massive bite. She blushes to see you staring at her, eyes wide, before hastily changing the topic.\n\n"I-I've discovered that Azrael was once a mercenary who infiltrated Azmoth. H-Here's some proof."

normal.textMain: Pretend you didn't hear anything.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You pretend you can't hear Hellin's stomach rumbling and ask if she's found anything.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result: Hellin tells you that she ran into a demon warrior, clearly a hunter on some unknown mission. Hellin suspects that the woman ventured into the chasm for money, hoping to claim the bounties on Aidan, Azrael, and Infernus. Though the hunter said little, Hellin is sure she heard something about the curse of Morghulas. But without anything to eat, the Thief Priest decides to return to base camp, and gives you an item she found.

normal.textMain: This is too awkward. Leave.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#Your own stomach rumbles in sympathy with Hellin's, and you flee the chamber to avoid the awkwardness.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: Hellin watches you go with hungry eyes, before stumbling off to see if there are any old leather boots she can boil.

9.desc: You're startled to come across a man standing alone on the path ahead of you, a heavy book in his hands. From the horns on his head, he's clearly a demon, but he seems to be some kind of scholar rather than a warrior. His shining eyes dart up to you briefly.\n\n"You clearly lack learning, but you can't be without skill if you've made it this far into the chasm. What do you say? Perhaps we can help each other."

normal.textMain: Offer him the Azmothian silver coin.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You offer the #fc0xccffffff#Azmothian silver coin#fc0xccc7dfe0# to the scholar.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, #prop1% chance to gain a level\nCan only be enhanced with higher-level items of the same effect
normal.result:
The demon scholar accepts the silver coin, holding it up so it catches the light.

"The silver itself is of little value, but the coin may be of great worth to certain... collectors who find themselves sentimental over their memories of lost Azmoth."
The scholar presses an item into your hand in exchange for the coin.

special.textMain: Offer him Drak's torn notes.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You offer #fc0xccffffff#Drak's torn notes#fc0xccc7dfe0# to the scholar.
special.textSub: Use #itemGive, recover #returnCost stamina, #prop1% chance to gain a level, #prop2% chance to gain two levels\nObtain higher level items at a set probability.
special.result: The scholar's eyes burn with excitement as he snatches the torn page from your hand, pouring over the notes with abandon. With a wild smile, he fishes something out of his bag, pressing it into your hands and dismissing you with a wave. As you walk away, unease settles heavily around your shoulders. What was in the notes you gave him?

normal.textMain: Ask what he is researching.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#Swallowing nervously, you ask what the scholar is researching in Azmoth Chasm.
normal.textSub: Recover #returnCost stamina, obtain items at a set probability
normal.result:
For the first time, the scholar's eyes leave his book for more than a moment, piercing you with a heavy stare. Unnerved by the look in his eyes, you're about to apologize when the scholar begins to speak.

"Oh... you might call me a historian... of sorceries long past."
You suspect that there's more to the story, but before you can summon the courage to ask the demon scholar reaches into his bag. With a dismissive gesture, he tosses you an item he no longer has use for.

normal.textMain: Time to leave. You've seen too many horror movies to fall for this.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You slowly back away, weapon at the ready.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: Keeping your eyes on the scholar, you slowly back out the way you came. The scholar's gaze never leaves his book, but there's a faint smile on his lips. His whisper flies through the air after you:\n\n"You'll need a stronger heart than that to survive the chasm..."

0.desc: As you pass into a shaded grotto, you suddenly stop short: the ghostly figure of a girl stands at the far end, the edges of her body twisting into the darkness. Though you can't hear her, it's clear that there are tears streaming down her face... Could there be a way to ease her suffering? She might be able to help you navigate the perils of the chasm.

normal.textMain: Show her Drak's research notes.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You show her #fc0xccffffff#Drak's research notes#fc0xccc7dfe0#.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result:
The girl recoils in terror as you take out the worn notebook, vanishing into the shadows. But after a long moment she reappears, searching your face and realizing that you have nothing to do with the author of the notes. Trembling with effort, she tries to say something to you... But as she struggles to speak, all you can hear is the wind twisting through the chasm. As the spirit finally fades into the shadows, you suddenly understand what she was trying to say:

"My life... was taken... by the same hand... which wrote those notes..."
In the sands where she was standing, an item glints in the dim light.

special.textMain: Show her the homemade hairpin.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccffffff#You show her the homemade hairpin.
special.result: The girl's eyes widen in silent surprise, hope breaking across her face like an unlooked for dawn. She steps forward, brushing a spectral hand over the hairpin, her icy touch sending chills down your arm. Suddenly you're blinking away your own tears as pictures form in your mind's eye... A father and daughter captured together, dreaming of escape and hiding a treasure their tormentors never found.

normal.textMain: Ignore the girl and walk away, hoping to escape her notice.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You ignore the girl and quickly walk by, hoping to escape her notice.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: Troubled by the tormented soul, you turn around, hoping to put as much distance between you and the girl as possible. But in your haste you lose your footing, tumbling down further into the chasm...

1.desc: The cat of the chasm looks over you, weighing you worth at a glance. Your eyes are irresistibly drawn to the ornate key hanging around its neck. But as you reach towards it with a shaking hand, an imperious voice suddenly whispers in your mind:\n\n"Even in Azmoth Chasm, it's considered rude to take from others without asking."

normal.textMain: Bow your head in apology and offer the cat a trade.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You apologize to the cat, showing it the treasures you're willing to trade.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: The cat purrs with satisfaction as you apologize, its keen eyes falling over the bulging backpack you set before it. With a twitch of its tail, the backpack vanishes, leaving a new item in its place.

special.textMain: Show the cat the strange dagger you found.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You take out the #fc0xccffffff#strange dagger#fc0xccc7dfe0# and show it to the cat.
special.result: The cat of the chasm sits up, its tail twitching with excitement. "Azrael's dagger..." the imperious voice in your mind whispers breathlessly as the cat's pupils widen into dark pools. The key around the cat's neck lifts into the air, turning as if unlocking a vault door, and a treasure is suddenly laid out before you.

normal.textMain: Listen to the chill running down your spine and leave.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You turn away, a cold shiver running down your spine.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: Dark laughter fills your mind, fading into a satisfied purr. Suddenly, you hear footsteps coming from every direction, and when you turn back the cat has vanished.

2.desc: As you approach the ruins ahead of you, the air suddenly fills with screams and explosions. You creep forward, weapons at the ready, only to stumble across an arcane turret vibrating with a low hum. Slain monsters are spread out around it, their corpses still steaming from the magical attacks that slew them. You've seen a number of arcane turrets spread around the chasm, their crystals cracked and their energy long-since faded... but this one still has some lingering power.

normal.textMain: Examine the area with your research gear.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You reach into your #fc0xccffffff#Explorer's Pack#fc0xccc7dfe0# and pull out your research gear.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: You spend some time searching through the corpses strewn about the arcane turret, seeing if you can find anything useful.

special.textMain: Throw the vial of viscous blood at the crystal.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You throw the #fc0xccffffff#vial of viscous blood#fc0xccc7dfe0# at the turret, showering it in spray of glass and sour blood.
special.result: The vial shatters at it hits the arcane turret, dousing the crystal in putrid blood. It begins burning with a sickly red light as the turret lashes out blindly, blasting the ruins around you with beams of sinister energy. Soon the crystal starts to shake and whine, and you barely make it behind cover as an explosion tears the turret apart! Once the dust cloud settles, you pick through the rubble to find what the turret was protecting.

normal.textMain: Back away slowly, never taking your eyes off the turret.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You slowly back away from the turret, never taking your eyes off it.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: The arcane turret vibrates suspiciously before quieting once more.

3.desc: You find the demon hunter standing over the body of fallen foe, using its tattered cape to wipe the black blood from her claymore. The horns on her head swivel towards you as she turns her head, assessing you with a cool stare.\n\n"Still enduring Morghulas's Curse, I see... What is your purpose here?"

normal.textMain: Tell her that you know nothing about any curses... you're just here to trade.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You tell the demon hunter that you don't know anything about any curse. Instead, you ask if she has anything to trade.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: The hunter raises a dubious brow, clearly skeptical that anyone would be foolhardy enough to brave Azmoth Chasm without preparing for its curse. Eyes glinting with silent mirth, she reaches down to the corpse at her feet before straightening up and throwing a pouch to you. By the time you look up again, she's gone.

special.textMain: Show her Drak's portrait.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You show her #fc0xccffffff#Drak's portrait#fc0xccc7dfe0# and ask if she knows anything about it.
special.result: The demon hunter examines Drak's portrait for a long moment, quietly wondering how anyone ever trusted a man of such naked ambition. She tells you that though Azmoth fell long ago, a rumor's persisted that Drak liked to hide secrets in the frames of his paintings. She offers you a trade--your portrait for an artifact of her own.

normal.textMain: Leave. You don't talk to strangers.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You were always told not to talk to strangers, so you turn to leave.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: The hunter smirks, strapping her blade across her back. With a rush of air, she spreads her wings and departs into the shadows.

4.desc: You round a corner, only to be knocked onto your backside as something warm and fuzzy collides with your chest. Blinking, you take in the sight of a terrified Fanzy, whose tail is puffed up in fright.\n\n"We need to get out of here! The people here were crazy! They... they tried to make a Transcendant!"

normal.textMain: Tell Fanzy that you may have found proof to back him up.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You reach into your bag to show Fanzy what you've found.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: Fanzy nods his head frantically, shoving the stone into his pack and spilling out a waterfall of coins. He tells you that he found traces of a bloody massacre in Azmoth, and asks you to be careful before sprinting away at breakneck speeds.

special.textMain: Give Fanzy the ritual scroll you found.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You hand #fc0xccffffff#Drak's ritual scroll#fc0xccc7dfe0# to Fanzy, who accepts it with wide eyes.
special.result: Fanzy takes one look at the dark symbols scrawled across the papyrus scroll before hurriedly rolling it up in terror. He hypothesizes that the ritual was the source of the dreadful curse upon Azmoth, but says he can't be sure until he consults with his master. Grateful for your help, Fanzy offers you one of the artifacts he found while investigating.

normal.textMain: Look around. Someone's watching you.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#Feeling eyes on your back, you turn your head slowly.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: You turn your head to see the cat of the chasm, who is looking at Fanzy curiously. Fanzy leaps into the air when he sees the cat, tail puffed, and flees further into Azmoth. The cat slowly stalks after him, greatly amused. You shake your head as you watch the two of them go, allowing some monsters to creep up on you.

5.desc: You catch sight of 10 Boogies, dressed in her explorer's gear, deep in thought as she writes her report. So deep in thought, in fact, that she doesn't notice the slavering monsters creeping up on her.

normal.textMain: Throw something at 10 Boogies to alert her.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You throw the #fc0xccffffff#grave robber's bulging backpack#fc0xccc7dfe0# at 10 Boogies, accidentally hitting her dead on.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: After slaying the monsters, you look around for 10 Boogies... only to realize that you accidentally knocked her off a cliff! You peek over the edge, bracing yourself, but can't see her through the gloom. Fortunately, you can just barely make out her voice as she complains about the tumble, so you pick up the pack she dropped and continue on your way. She'll be okay, you tell yourself... and you're probably right.

special.textMain: Throw the demonic idol at the monsters.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#The #fc0xccffffff#demonic idol#fc0xccc7dfe0# vibrates in your bag, and you throw it at the monsters approaching 10 Boogies.
special.result: The demonic idol bursts into black flames as it hits the lead monster, consuming the whole pack in an explosion of unholy energy. 10 Boogies looks up from her report, completely oblivious to the danger she was in, and notices you for the first time. "I have something for you!" she says with a wide grin.

normal.textMain: Call out a warning to 10 Boogies.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You yell a warning to 10 Boogies, hoping to warn her.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: 10 Boogies looks up from her report absentmindedly, jumping as she locks eyes with the approaching monsters and running off in fright. The vicious creatures turn towards you, hungry and furious.

6.desc: As you pass through a cavernous ruin, you hear the sound of combat ahead. Rushing forward you see an adventurer fending off a horde of monsters. With a start you realize it's Athena Pierce, fighting atop a mountain of bodies as more monsters rush in. Her voice rings out, telling you to run while she holds the enemy off.

normal.textMain: Cast the emergency protection spell you found.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You cast the #fc0xccffffff#emergency protection spell#fc0xccc7dfe0# on yourself and Athena, and the two of you rush into the fray.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: It's a hard fight, but in the end you and Athena make short work of the monsters. Afterwards, she examines the bodies of your fallen foes and declares that they were once highly-ranked warriors in Azmoth. You spy something suspicious gleaming beneath the arm of a particularly fearsome monster.

special.textMain: Take out the largest Golem with your Golem Self-Destruct Scroll.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You open the #fc0xccffffff#Golem Self-Destruct Scroll#fc0xccc7dfe0# and point your hand at the largest golem attacking Athena.
special.result: With a single word of command, you shatter the most fearsome-looking golem into twisted pieces. After the battle, you and Athena look over the golem's remains... and make a horrifying discovering. Athena reaches into the golem's shattered chassis and pulls out a strange crystal, which burns with a violent glow.\n\n"Can you feel it? This was made by sacrificing a living soul..."

normal.textMain: There's no time to lose. Trust Athena Pierce and keep moving.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#There's no time to lose, so you silently wish Athena Pierce luck and move on before most of the monsters notice you.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: You decide that Athena Pierce can look after herself and keep on moving. After all, she's been in worse scraps and gotten out fine... right?

7.desc: As you work your way through the winding chasm, drums suddenly thrum in the deep. Enemies emerge from every corner and in mere moments you're completely surrounded. But just before you panic, the monsters around you begin to fall, arrows sprouting from their heads. High above you, Danika's face appears, beaming at you.

normal.textMain: Ask if she's found anything.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You ask Danika if she's found anything.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: Danika tells you about a golem she found in an abandoned alchemy lab. The construct was covered in dust, but Danika says that she felt a peculiar intelligence looking out from its hollow insides. Troubled, you show her the Tome of the High Sybarite, wondering if it might contain the secret of the golem's creation. Danika gingerly takes the tome from you, promising to bring it back for further research, before handing you an Advanced Explorer's Pack.

special.textMain: Show her the Encyclopedia of Infernus Husbandry.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You show Danika the #fc0xccffffff#Encyclopedia of Infernus Husbandry#fc0xccc7dfe0# and ask if she knows anything.
special.result: Danika carefully examines the Encyclopedia of Infernus Husbandry, but it's written in a language neither of you have ever seen before. From the little she can decipher, it's clear that the Inferni are neither summoned nor demonic, but instead were created by the unique sorceries of Azmoth. After looking through a few of the blood-curdling illustrations, Danika wonders if the Inferni were made by mistake, a magical mishap that the rulers of Azmoth came to regret. Tucking the book away, she hands you an artifact in thanks.

normal.textMain: Thank Danika and promise not to let your guard down.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You thank Danika and promise not to let your guard down.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: You thank Danika and move forward, keeping a wary eye on your surroundings.

8.desc: Hellin tells you that after searching every corner of the chasm, she's discovered the name of the tyrant sorcerer who once seized power here. He was called Drak, and she believes he met his doom alongside Azmoth. But to test her hypothesis, she needs to examine something carried by the demon mercenaries he lured here.

normal.textMain: Show her the Battle-Hammered Gladiator's Amulet.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You show Hellin the #fc0xccffffff#CBattle-Hammered Gladiator's Amulet#fc0xccc7dfe0# you found.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, obtain #itemGet
normal.result: As Hellin examines the amulet, she wonders what hand the former master of Azmoth, Drak, had in the creation of the golem in the alchemy lab and the monster in the coliseum. Hellin says that she has one idea, but it's surely too ludicrous to be true. Troubled, she departs to continue her investigation, accidentally leaving something behind.

special.textMain: Hand over the demon mercenary badge.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#You hand over the #fc0xccffffff#demon mercenary badge#fc0xccc7dfe0#.
special.result:
Hellin examines the badge closely, and while you can't see her face, you think she might be smiling.

"As I expected, the monster in the coliseum was once Drak's prisoner. I believe his name was... Aidan. And the golem in the alchemy was once known as Azrael. But it's strange... How could Aidan and Azrael have been members of the same mercenary band?"

Left with more questions than answers, Hellin takes the badge. She presses something into your hand, saying that you'll need it.

normal.textMain: Tell her you're too busy to talk right now.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You tell Hellin that you can't talk now and head off in a hurry.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: Hellin nods once and disappears into thin air the moment you turn your back.

9.desc: You walk into a cavern, only to come up short. A demon scholar stands amidst blood-soaked sands, a field of enemies laying at his feet. He spares you a single glance before returning to his book, scribbling something in the margins. The air itself blisters with heat, as if it was on fire mere moments ago. Without looking up, the scholar begins to speak.\n\n"The hospitality of Azmoth is astounding, is it not? But... if you have any of the artifacts I'm searching for, I'll pay you handsomely. Particularly the blade Drak wielded in the creation of Morghulas... It would be... most dear to me."

normal.textMain: Offer him the gold coin.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You toss the #fc0xccffffff#gold coin#fc0xccc7dfe0# to the scholar, who catches it with one hand.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, #prop1% chance to gain a level\nCan only be enhanced with higher-level items of the same effect
normal.result:
The scholar chuckles as he examines the gold coin, the dark sound echoing off the cavern around you.

"Drak had kingly ambitions." he says, holding up the coin so it catches the torchlight. "Or, perhaps, I should say godly, if he truly wished to fashion himself into a Transcendant."
The scholar gives you a reward, saying the coin has little monetary worth, but is of the greatest sentimental value to him.

special.textMain: Offer him the Ruinous Ritual Blade.
special.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17#Swallowing nervously, you hand over the #fc0xccffffff#Ruinous Ritual Blade#fc0xccc7dfe0#.
special.textSub: Use #itemGive, recover #returnCost stamina, #prop1% chance to gain a level, #prop2% chance to gain two levels\nObtain higher level items at a set probability.
special.result:
The scholar gasps as you extend the Ruinous Ritual Blade, his eyes wide. Taking it with a trembling hand, a crazed grin erupts across his face.

"Drak was a fool who attempted to transform himself into an artificial Transcendent... He failed, of course, but his research led to uncounted sorcerous discoveries. The last of them being the curse of Morghulas, a disaster that claimed the life of Drak and Azmoth both."
Never taking his eyes off the dagger's blade, the scholar throws a bag to your feet. "Payment for services rendered."

normal.textMain: Get out of there. What madman reads a book in a dungeon?
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#Unwilling to trust the scholar, you turn to leave.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: You turn your back on the scholar, unwilling to trust a stranger seeking knowledge in the ruins of Azmoth. As you start to leave, you suddenly hear a group of monsters charging in behind you. You turn around, ready to fight, realizing in the moments before the monsters reach you that the scholar is long gone.

0.desc: A bloody, battle-scarred demon stands before you, her armor covered in the scratches of uncounted blows. Beneath her, the body of another demon lays, staining the sand around it. The warrior speaks, her voice overjoyed:\n\n"Good timing! My contract here just ended. My client didn't have enough to cover fighting Aidan, Azrael, or Infernus, so I took the payment I was owed. But... there's always more money to be made. The artifacts here are quite valuable, especially anything touched by that tyrant Drak, like his research notes. Give me something and I'll tell you how to fight your way out of here. Of course, if you'd rather face the masters of the chasm on your own, be my guest."

normal.textMain: Give her Drak's research notes.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You hand over #fc0xccffffff#Drak's research notes#fc0xccc7dfe0#.
normal.textSub: Use #itemGive, recover #returnCost stamina, weaken elite Azmothian Guardians
normal.result:
#fcFFFF8A18#The Elite Azmothian Guardians have been weakened.#fcFFBED0D3#
Tucking Drak's research notes into her armor with a satisfied smirk, the warrior turns and looks you keenly. Before you can react, her lips are at your ear, whispering the secrets of the cursed monsters ahead of you. Long after she leaves, her last words ring in your mind...

"Nice doing business with you. We'll see each other soon."

normal.textMain: Ignore her offer.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You turn down her offer, uneasy around this battle-mad mercenary.
normal.textSub: Start a combat encounter according to set probability rates
normal.result: #fcFFFF8A18#The Elite Azmothian Guardians have been weakened.#fcFFBED0D3#\nYou ignore her offer and move on. The warrior gives you a feral grin, her pointed teeth bloody, and you feel her eyes on your back until you're finally out of sight.

0.desc: The dark energy of Azmoth Chasm seeps into your body, draining the strength from your limbs and sapping your will. You struggle to keep your eyes open, but the cursed earth seems to whisper to you, promising that all you need is a moment of rest. You close your eyes, waiting for the horrors of the chasm to pass over you like a bad dream... when suddenly, gentle hands grab you by the shoulders and shake you awake! It's the Halflinger Relief Expedition, dispatched by the Alchemists of Magatia to find you. As they pull you to your feet, they say that they've brought you emergency supplies.

normal.textMain: Thank them for their help and see what they've brought you.
normal.textPopUp: #fnArial##fs17##fc0xccc7dfe0#You thank the Halflingers for their help and see what they've brought you.
normal.textSub: Obtain an item according to set probability rates
normal.result: After picking the Magatia support item that seems most useful to you, you say goodbye to the Halflingers, who depart in good cheer.\n\n"Happy hunting! We're off to find other adventurers who need help!"

enchantNotice.noItemMsg:
The demon scholar levels a cool gaze towards the item you handed to him.

"Simply accepting a request ill-suits my nature... Let's see...
Give me another of the items you carry."
enchantNotice.itemGiveMsg:
A hint of a smile crosses the demon scholar's face.

"Does it send a shiver down your spine, trading treasure in Azmoth Chasm?
Quell your fears and give me another item to work with."
enchantNotice.endItemMsg:
The demon scholar raises a single eyebrow.

"There does not seem to be anything left for me to do with this.
Do you have any other items?"
enchantNotice.consumeItemMsg: The demon scholar shakes his head.\n\n"Even touching an item such as this risks destroying it irrevocably."

0.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by #finalDamR% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 30. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nIf you're crazy enough to descend into Azmoth Chasm, you'll need the right gear! This pack may not help you in combat, but mark my words, you'll be glad to have it in the end.

1.name: Advanced Explorer's Pack
1.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by #finalDamR% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 50. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThis pack may weigh you down a bit, but it's full of gear to help you through the perils of Azmoth Chasm. You'll face more than monsters, after all.

2.name: Veteran Explorer's Pack
2.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by #finalDamR% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 100. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe only way we'll ever truly understand the fate of Azmoth is to examine every inch of the chasm with specialized gear... Just make sure you're ready for some rough fights, all right?

3.name: Vile Lash
3.desc: #cIncreases points earned after stopping the Azmothian Guardians within 60 seconds by 50.#\nOn the day of Azmoth's ruin, more than one of its nobles learned that pain and fear can only stay a vengeful hand for so long...

4.name: Vicious Lash
4.desc: #cIncreases points earned upon stopping the Azmothian Guardians within 60 seconds by 100.#\nThe ruin of Azmoth was not justice. How could it be, when weighed against the torment Azmoth wrought, the blood the city spilled? Stand in this grave of uncounted dreams and realize that what some would call justice was merely a relief.

5.name: Drak's Research Notes
5.desc: A #cresearch record# written in some lost language. Based on the images and the maddened scrawl, whoever wrote this did something unspeakable.

6.name: Alchemist Stone
6.desc: #cChanges into an Awakened Black Stone after advancing #x times in a row.#\nCreated by an alchemist of Azmoth, it could easily pass for a normal stone.

7.name: Black Alchemist Stone
7.desc: #cChanges into an Awakened Black Stone after advancing #x times in a row.#\nCreated by an alchemist of Azmoth, it could easily pass for a normal stone.

8.name: Awakened Stone
8.desc: #cIncreases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 90.#\nUnable to trust each other with their most prized secrets, the alchemists of Azmoth created advisors of a more unnatural source. As you stare into the weeping eyes of this stone, it whispers its dark counsel in the back of your mind.

9.name: Awakened Black Stone
9.desc: #cIncreases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 220.#\nThe alchemists of Azmoth hoarded knowledge from each other, only trusting their secrets to living stones, servants supposedly bound to the will of their creator. But as you see this stone open its eyes and hear its whispered words of temptation, you wonder at the wisdom of their choice.

10.name: Grave Robber's Backpack
10.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by #finalDamR% for each bound item owned. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nMore than one grave robber has braved the depths of Azmoth Chasm looking for treasure... Seeing as the former owner of this pack is nowhere to be seen, you have a good idea of what happened to them.

11.name: Grave Robber's Bulging Backpack
11.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by #finalDamR% for each bound item owned. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nAzmoth Chasm is full of treasures waiting to be plundered by a savvy grave robber... But let this over-full pack be a reminder: no matter how much you triumph here, death is never far.

12.name: Whispering Tome
12.desc: #cIncreases stamina reduction by #enterCostSystemHP and Final Damage by #finalDamR% upon entering Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nAs you pick up the Whispering Tome, your mind runs cold and your breath dies in your throat. You can almost hear its sibilant song of the sorcerers of Azmoth... and the great terror they worked in their dark towers.

13.name: Tome of the High Sybarite
13.desc: #cIncreases stamina reduction by #enterCostSystemHP and Final Damage by #finalDamR% upon entering Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nA tome warm with a sickening heat, as if it were a living thing. As you take it in your hands, you can see the glories of lost Azmoth, its rioting gardens and unfathomable sorceries... and the blood soaked into its stones. Look at the ruin around you, hero. And remember that all greed has its price.

14.name: Gladiator's Amulet
14.desc: #cIncreases damage taken by #mobFinalDamR% and Final Damage by #finalDamR% after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe nobles of Azmoth once thought to mock their gladiators with amulets of purest silver, little realizing that by forcing their captives to fight and die in the coliseum, they were forging a blade that would turn against them on the day ruin came.

15.name: Battle-Hammered Gladiator's Amulet
15.desc: #cIncreases damage taken by #mobFinalDamR% and Final Damage by #finalDamR% after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe berserkers were the most unfortunate captives in Azmoth's coliseum, gladiators driven mad by foul poisons and fouler sorceries. But they never fought with more ferocity than on the day Azmoth crumbled, when their battle fury was fueled not by hate and torment, but hope.

16.name: Emergency Protection Spell
16.desc: #cSeals chasm item effects, defends against stamina decreases based on time remaining, and recovers an additional #y stamina when a stage ends #x times.#\nA scroll of protective magic, fashioned by an ancient wizard to protect his pupils. It will preserve you from the horrors of Azmoth for a time, but it will also seal away any beneficial effects from cursed objects.\n...For some reason, the scroll is covered in cat hair.

19.name: Demon Rag Doll
19.desc: A rag doll of a #cdemon child#, complete with wings and horns. It was sewn with deepest love, and once comforted a young girl through many nights of bitter tears.

20.name: Barbed Arrowheads
20.desc: A handful of ancient arrowheads, still gleaming with a #clethal light# though the rest of the arrow has long since rotted way. A cruel hand fashioned them to inflict the maximum amount of pain.

21.name: Dusty Blood Vial
21.desc: The glass of this vial is fogged with dirt, but the dark red color of the liquid sloshing around inside is unmistakable. It is full of #cblood#, which looks as fresh as the day it was drawn.

22.name: Wanted Posters
22.desc: A sheaf of crumbling wanted posters, yellow with age. In place of criminals, each dusty page depicts a different fugitive demon who made a #cpowerful enemy#.

23.name: Arcane Defense Manual
23.desc: A ponderous tome detailing the schematics for the #carcane turrets# of Azmoth. Buried deep in its labyrinthine pages is the knowledge of the turrets' power source, an arcane fuel derived from a resource the rulers of Azmoth had in plentiful supply: demon blood.

24.name: Bloody Alchemy Tools
24.desc: You don't know what kind of #calchemy experiment# requires a sawtooth blade, bandages, and a bottle of preservative solution... but you hope you never find out.

25.name: Heretical Icon
25.desc: A diamond icon of heretical faith, with a #clidless eye# at its heart. In the flickering light, the pupil almost seems to be following your movements...

26.name: Gnawed Femur
26.desc: A #cmassive femur# from a creature unknown, now covered in tooth marks. A doctor might say it that looks more like a finger bone than a femur, but what monster could have a hand that big?

27.name: Emergency Rations
27.desc: Emergency rations cached by the advance exploration team. It doesn't look like anything has broken the seal, so they #cshould# be safe to eat.

28.name: Drak's Torn Notes
28.desc: A #ctorn page#, covered in an indescribable script. No one in their right mind would want to decipher what it says.

29.name: Homemade Hairpin
29.desc: A #chomemade hairpin#, created in hopes of bringing some small comfort to a distraught child. Examining the pin closely, you realize that it would be the perfect tool for picking the lock on a pair of manacles.

30.name: Strange Dagger
30.desc: A #cperfectly ordinary dagger#, well-used but well-maintained. Its handle is bare of device and it is identical to a thousand other blades you've seen in your adventures... so why does holding it make your heart run cold?

31.name: Vial of Viscous Blood
31.desc: At first, the dark red liquid inside this vial appears solid, with immobile bubbles pressed up against the glass. But as hours pass, the bubbles slowly rise and you realize the liquid is boiling in slow motion. Just what kind of #cblood# is inside?

32.name: Portrait of a Would-be God
32.desc: A dirty, once luxurious portrait of a #chorned demon#, gazing out towards the viewer with a haughty expression. His eyes shine with ambition and there's a self-indulgent twist to his smile. The golden label on the frame bears the name #cDrak#.

33.name: Drak's Ritual Scroll
33.desc: #cPlans written in an indescribable script#. The few illustrations you can decipher seem to detail gold, artifacts, and an ocean of blood...

34.name: Demonic Idol
34.desc: A small idol of a horned and winged demon carved out of dark stone. For some reason, you feel your arm curling into a #cthrowing motion# as you hold it.

35.name: Golem Self-Destruct Scroll
35.desc: Every alchemist in Azmoth carried a copy of this scroll at their hip, no matter where they were. They knew it was their last defense against a #cgolem# gone rogue.

36.name: The Encyclopedia of Infernus Husbandry
36.desc: A thick compendium perfect for any delusional soul hoping to rear an #cInfernus# of their very own. The illustrations of the proper feeding methods would give you nightmares if they weren't so cute.

37.name: Demon Mercenary Badge
37.desc: Handheld proof of the owner's membership in a #cmercenary company#. You have no idea why the sellsword band came to the cursed land of Azmoth, but it's clear that despite their preparations none returned alive.

38.name: Ruinous Ritual Blade
38.desc: The curse seeping from this #cmysterious ritualistic blade# is so incredibly vile, it might just be the source of the ruin that befell Azmoth Chasm.

39.name: Azmothian Ore
39.desc: #cSummons 1 Goldeater after successfully completing a Vanguard Defense or Azmothian Guardians and increases points earned by slaying Goldeaters by 300.#\nAs Azmoth's doom approached, the paranoid rulers of the city descended into fratricidal strife. To protect themselves from their so-called allies, they created a mysterious ore that marked their fiercest enemies with a golden glow.

40.name: Burning Azmothian Ore
40.desc: #cSummons 2 Goldeaters after successfully completing a Vanguard Defense or Azmothian Guardians and increases points earned by slaying Goldeaters by 300.#\nTell me... what good is a metal that marks your deadliest foes gold when every friend comes wearing a knife-edged smile and every servant stokes fire in their heart?

41.name: Sorcerer's Veil
41.desc: #c#x% stamina reduction 1 time when rechallenging after a failing to move forward.#\nThis veil is comfortable, almost refreshing, on your face... but its origins in a dark sect of sorcerers undeniably pulls at your mind at times.

42.name: Silken Sorcerer's Veil
42.desc: #c#x% stamina reduction 1 time when rechallenging after a failing to move forward.#\nNothing quite feels as good as this silken covering on your face... and that thought threatens to lead your mind down darker paths.

43.name: Grim Epaulette
43.desc: #cIncreases the chances of finding a higher-ranked item when you get the next item.#\nDrak's personal guards were marked with these epaulettes, signaling their viciousness and cruelty to those they made demands of.

44.name: Threatening Epaulette
44.desc: #cIncreases the chances of finding a higher-ranked item when you get the next item.#\nDrak's most trusted guards wore these epaulettes, indicating that their every demand must be acknowledged, on pain of death.

45.name: Guardbreaker Pendant
45.desc: #cLowers the difficulty for the next Azmothian Guardians.#\nThis pendant bears a power that can repel Azmoth's guardians, but it does not appear to have done its long-departed owner much good.

50.name: Unproven Demonic Inoculant
50.desc: #cRecover #incSystemHP stamina.#\nMagatia's alchemists hastily concocted this serum to counteract demonic influences, but it lacked essential potency.

51.name: Demonic Inoculant
51.desc: #cRecover #incSystemHP stamina.#\nAfter some urgent reformulation, Magatia's alchemists were able to produce this effective serum.

52.name: Special Demonic Inoculant
52.desc: #cRecover #incSystemHP stamina.#\nThis potent serum was the result of tireless, sometimes desperate refinement from Magatia's alchemists.

53.name: Magatia's Support
53.desc: The alchemists of Magatia have spared no expense to support the exploration of Azmoth Chasm. You may not know exactly what this experimental potion will do... but you're pretty sure it'll be beneficial.

54.name: Strawberry-Scented Syrup
54.desc: #cPrevent HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once.#\nA simple sweetener gifted from father to daughter can be all the motivation one needs to push past their limits.

55.name: Father's Keepsake
55.desc: #cPrevent HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once and increase Final Damage by #finalDamR%. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nA beloved father concocted this powerful potion with the best of intentions, but tragically never saw it used.

56.name: Artifact Case
56.desc: #cGrants a chance to get an epic chasm item.#\nLayered with years of dust and marked with desperate gashes, this unassuming box could hold a most precious treasure.

57.name: Artifact Reliquary
57.desc: #cGrants a chance to get a unique chasm item.#\nBattered and grimy, one would never expect this box to be so hotly pursued for the rumored relic within.

58.name: Azmothian Crystal
58.desc: #cIncrease Final Damage by #finalDamR% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThis ephemeral crystal constantly emits steam and light, lending its strength to those around it.

59.name: Azmothian Blood Crystal
59.desc: #cIncrease Final Damage by #finalDamR% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nWreathed in steam and crimson light, this crystal fills your soul with newfound power.

60.name: Hunter's Talisman
60.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 500 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nDemon hunters take any advantage they can get, and this grim keepsake is said to bring them good fortune.

61.name: Horrifying Talisman
61.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nNo one would think these vicious claws could bring good luck, but demon hunters are cut from a very different cloth.

62.name: Fanzy's Energy Tonic
62.desc: #cRecover #incSystemHP stamina.#\nThe mind is your most precious resource in Azmoth, a fact that led Fanzy to create this mentally-reinforcing draught.

63.name: Fanzy's Special Tonic
63.desc: #cRecover #incSystemHP stamina.#\nFanzy's experiences in the chasm may have given him nightmares, but they also allowed him to perfect the formula for his tincture, providing a powerful reinforcement against the withering horrors of Azmoth.

64.name: 10 Boogies's Evidence Sack
64.desc: #cGrants a chance to get an epic chasm item.#\n10 Boogies has been gathering up all kinds of suspicious items to report on. Surely there must be something worthwhile here...

65.name: 10 Boogies's Special Evidence Sack
65.desc: #cGrants a chance to get a unique chasm item.#\n10 Boogies set this particular sack of questionable items aside, which suggests there may be especially good stuff inside.

66.name: Azmothian Alchemy Crystal
66.desc: #cRecover #incSystemHP stamina.#\nSomething must have shocked this red crystal into forming, given its strange shape. The vital energies radiating from it are definitely stranger still.

67.name: Forbidden Alchemy Crystal
67.desc: #cRecover #incSystemHP stamina.#\nThe life energy seeping from this crystal is powerful enough to seriously question how such a thing could be made...and what the cost of that process could have been.

68.name: Coliseum Booster
68.desc: #cIncrease Final Damage by #finalDamR% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe blue crystal inside this bottle vaporizes when exposed to air, and whatever power it contains transfers to those around it.

69.name: Red Coliseum Booster
69.desc: #cIncrease Final Damage by #finalDamR% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nWhatever this red crystal is, it fills you with seemingly unholy strength once unbottled.

70.name: Azrael's Note
70.desc: #cIncrease points obtained by 500 during next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nAzrael collected his thoughts about Azmoth's structure here, which could be quite valuable to the expedition.

71.name: Azrael's Journal
71.desc: #cIncrease points earned by 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nWith more experiences to draw on, Azrael outlined nearly the full scope of Azmoth in this extensive journal. The information within is absolutely invaluable.

72.name: Azmothian Silver Coin
72.desc: A #ccoin# featuring a portrait of a horned individual. Who knows how valuable this could be?
